stories.title: Bryn Williams team to run new daytime café at Theatr Clwyd
stories.summary: A daytime café will open at Theatr Clwyd in Mold on Monday 24 August, run by the team behind the venue’s Bryn Williams restaurant. stories.title: Mold bus station users asked to avoid cordoned benches during works
stories.summary: Work has started on refurbishing the benches at Mold bus station, with only a small number taken out of use at a time so the rest stay available to passengers. stories.title: Plans to turn 197-year-old chapel into cottage submitted to Flintshire Council
stories.summary: A 197-year-old Wesleyan Methodist chapel in Flintshire may soon be transformed into a four-bedroom cottage. Seion Chapel in Lloc was originally built in 1810, but was rebuilt in 1829 in its current form. stories.title: More than 600 children a day using Flintshire summer playschemes
stories.summary: More than 600 children a day are attending Flintshire’s free summer playschemes, with places still open at some of the 49 sites running through the holidays.
